Interdict Supply Line

Cut a supply-path hex feeding an enemy siege. Strips the hex's 'Supply Line' modifier (severs the route until restored) and lands an immediate harassment pulse: the besieger's Supply Buffer is shaved and per-turn attrition rises. Any Domain except the besieger may interdict. Target the supply-road hex, not the besieged hex.

Cost: Intrigue 15 · Violence 10 marks
